content.text: # Code review: `interface/forms/eye_mag/report.php` ## Critical / High ### 1. SQL injection and cross-patient document leak in `display_draw_image()` ```php $base_name = $pid."_".$encounter."_".$side."_".$zone."_VIEW"; $sql = "SELECT * from documents where documents.url like '%".$filename."'"; ``` - **SQL injection.** `$encounter` is concatenated directly into the SQL. - In `custom_report.php` it comes from `$form_encounter = $val`, which is a raw `$_GET`/`$_POST` value. - It can also come from `$_REQUEST['encid']` at the top of this file. - **PHI leak.** The leading `%` wildcard has no `foreign_id = pid` filter. A pattern for pid=1, encounter=5 (`%1_5_OU_EXT_VIEW.jpg`) also matches `11_5_OU_EXT_VIEW.jpg` and `21_5_...`. Another patient's drawing can be shown in this patient's report. - **Fix:** - Bind parameters. - Add `AND foreign_id = ?`. - Match the exact filename or path suffix. - Also note that `$document_id > '1'` wrongly excludes document id 1. ### 2. File-scope request handling overrides the patient context when included `custom_report.php` does `include_once ".../forms/$formdir/report.php"`. That means all top-level code in this file runs in the report's global scope: ```php if ($_REQUEST['ptid']) $pid = $_REQUEST['ptid']; if ($_REQUEST['encid']) $encounter=$_REQUEST['encid']; if ($_REQUEST['formid']) $form_id = $_REQUEST['formid']; if ($_REQUEST['formname']) $form_name=$_REQUEST['formname']; ``` - A request parameter can silently switch `$pid` for the entire custom report, with no ACL check. This is an IDOR that exposes other patients' data. - **Fix:** Move this code out of `report.php`. It should only define functions. ### 3. Variable-variable injection from preferences at global scope ```php $LOCATION = $prefs['LOCATION']; $$LOCATION = text($prefs['GOVALUE']); ``` - This runs in the global scope of `custom_report.php`. - A pref row whose `LOCATION` is `pid`, `PDF_OUTPUT`, `printable`, `auth_med`, etc. will clobber core globals. - At minimum, whitelist the names. Better, put prefs in an array. ### 4. Short open tags (`` conversion and no escaping. Use `nl2br(text(...))`. - **Orders:** `$PLAN` items and `$PLAN2`. - **Notes and signature:** `$note->get_note()` and `$providerNAME` in the PDF signature. - **Exam values:** `$CTLOSVA` and all `$MOTILITY_*` values. - **Image paths:** `$from_file` and `$filetoshow` in `src` attributes, and `$form_folder` in the Amsler `img src`. ### 6. `extract()` clobbers function parameters and the queries can pick the wrong form - In `narrative()`, `@extract($encounter_data)` pulls in `form_encounter.*` and `form_eye_mag.*`. This includes `pid`, `encounter`, `id`, and the aliased `form_id`, overwriting the `$form_id` argument passed by the caller. - **The query ignores the requested form:** - It does not filter by the `$form_id` the caller asked for. - It does not filter `forms.formdir='eye_mag'`. - It does not join `forms.pid`. - **Consequences:** - With multiple eye_mag forms in one encounter, an arbitrary one is shown. - Any other form in the encounter whose `form_id` collides with a `form_eye_mag.id` can also match. - The wearing and impplan lookups then use the wrong `$form_id`. - The same `extract` pattern in `eye_mag_report()` overwrites `$id`/`$pid`. - **Fix:** Query by `form_eye_mag.id = ?` and `formdir = 'eye_mag'`. Read fields from the array instead of extracting. ### 7. `$choice` handling is broken ```php if ($_REQUEST['CHOICE']) $choice = $_REQUEST['choice']; ``` - **Case mismatch:** the condition checks `CHOICE` but the assignment reads `choice`, so it essentially never works. - **Inverted default:** in `eye_mag_report()`, the final branch is `else if ($choice != "narrative")`. A `$choice` of `"narrative"` renders nothing, contrary to the doc comment ("If it is not present it will display everything == 'narrative'"). ## Medium — clinical-data correctness ### 8. Left-eye motility grid shows the wrong field - The bottom-left cell shows `$MOTILITY_LLIO`; it should be `$MOTILITY_LRIO`. As written, `LLIO` is displayed twice and `LRIO` never. ### 9. Motility variable-variable is ambiguous across PHP versions - `$$zone[$i]` means `${$zone[$i]}` in PHP 5 but `($$zone)[$i]` in PHP 7+. This breaks on newer PHP. - **Fix:** Use `${$zone[$i]}`. ### 10. Typos in display conditions that hide or misreport findings - `$ODNEARVA_1||$WNEAROSVA_1` should use `$OSNEARVA_1`. - `$ODGONIO||$OSDGONIO` should use `$OSGONIO`. - `if ($ODNPC or $OSNPC)` displays `$NPC`, so the condition never matches the displayed value. Use `if ($NPC)`. - **Retina:** the condition `$ODDISC||$OSDISC||$ODCUP||$ODMACULA||$ODVESSELS||$ODPERIPH` omits the OS fields. Left-eye-only findings are not printed. - **Refraction box:** gated on `$ODVA||$OSVA`, which don't exist (the wearing data is `ODVA_1`, …). Current glasses Rx is omitted unless some other refraction exists. Check `$count_rx > 0`. - **Red Desaturation:** `title=""` is missing `echo`. - **ACT:** - The table renders when `$ACT != 'on'`. Verify this logic is intended. - The string `'sc Near{{without correction near'` is missing its closing `}}`. ### 11. Autorefraction comments use a stale loop variable - `${"COMMENTS_$i"}` is used after the Rx loop, where `$i == $count_rx+1`. It is undefined, or at best reads the wrong Rx's comment. ### 12. Leftover debug output - `xlt('Type').$count_rx` prints the Rx count in the column header. ### 13. Malformed HTML breaks html2pdf layout - **Pupils:** the `` is closed only inside the `if ($ODPUPILSIZE1||...)` branch. The "normal only" path leaves it unclosed. - **ACT:** `` sits inside the `if ($ACT5CCDIST)` block, so rows are unbalanced when ccDIST is absent. - **Column counts:** the refraction header has 10 cells but uses `colspan="9"`. - **Style attribute:** `` has a duplicate `style` attribute (it should be `class`). ## Low — maintainability and robustness - **Unsafe facility query:** - `"select * from facility where id=" . $_SESSION['pc_facility']` is string concatenation; bind it. - The result (`$facility`) and `$titleres` are never used. - **Undefined variables:** - `$css_header` inside `narrative()` is not declared global, so the stylesheet `href` is empty. - `$display_Add` is undefined. - `$bad` is uninitialized. - `$IMPPLAN_items` is uninitialized, so `foreach` warns when there are no rows. - **Dead code:** - `left_overs()` references undefined `$table_name`/`$id`. - `full_report()` is unreachable after `return;`. - There is a large commented-out `DRAW` block. - `display_draw_image()` computes an unused base image, `$to_file`, and `$extension`. - **Redundant work:** - `eye_mag_report()` runs a query only to compute `$visit_date`, which is unused. - The `$formname` parameter is ignored. - **Duplication:** the HPI blocks repeated ×3, the refraction rows, and the ACT grids repeated ×4 should be loops or helpers. - **Error suppression:** `@extract` hides errors. Remove the `@`. - **Deleted documents shown:** the patient photo and drawing lookups do not exclude deleted documents. - **Header block:** the duplicated license header still contains the Sketch plugin MIT text, which is unrelated to this file. - **Missing newline:** the file has no newline at EOF.
